# AGENTS.md - Jari

Keyboard-driven browser navigation extension. ES modules bundled with esbuild
into IIFE bundles (content scripts cannot use runtime ESM imports).

## Commands

```sh
npm install
npm run lint          # eslint, must be clean
npm test              # node --test, 71 unit tests
npm run build:chrome  # rebuild bundles + manifest.json for Chrome
npm run build:firefox # rebuild bundles + manifest.json for Firefox
```

E2E (needs Chromium + fresh profile, see `tests/e2e/README.md`):
```sh
npm run build:chrome
./tests/e2e/launch.sh "$PROFILE" "$(pwd)"
```

## Generated files - never hand-edit

- `content/bundle.js`, `options/options.bundle.js`, `background.js` (banner:
  `// Generated by build.js`)
- `manifest.json` (copied from `manifest.base.json` per target; checked-in
  copy targets Chrome)

Rebuild after touching anything under `content/`, `options/`,
`background/`, or `shared/`, and commit the rebuilt bundles alongside
source (repo convention).

## Layout

- `content/` - content scripts; `content.js` is the key dispatcher, `commands.js`
  maps catalog names to actions
- `content/hints-elements.js` - DOM queries/predicates (`isEditable`,
  `isFrameElement`, `getLinkAncestor`, selectors)
- `content/ui.js` - shared interaction primitives (`ui.consume`,
  `ui.safeFocus`, `ui.dispatchClick`, `ui.focusFrameElement`, toast/pills,
  `buildCategorizedGrid`)
- `content/hint-layer.js` - shared hint rendering (labels, host, layout,
  `yellow`/`cyan` themes); `content/highlight.js` - Highlight-API + span
  fallback helpers
- `background/` - service-worker source (`main.js` + `handlers.js`),
  `shared/` - `url.js` (URL parsing, scheme policy) + `constants.js`
- `options/` - options page; `tests/setup.mjs` - shared chrome/DOM stubs

## Conventions

- Smallest change that solves the task; prefer existing helpers in `ui.js`,
  `hints-elements.js`, `hint-layer.js`, `highlight.js`, `keymap.js`
  (`normalizeHintChars`, `balanceCategories`) over new code.
- Behavior-preserving refactors: verify edge cases (empty tab lists,
  `role=combobox`, clamp semantics, focus-then-activate order) before
  collapsing branches; keep one clear behavior per helper.
- No new abstractions, config, or deps unless necessary. Do not touch
  unrelated code or fix unrelated issues.
- `shared/url.js` scheme policy (`urlSchemes`, `blockedUrlSchemes`) is
  security-sensitive: keep `normalizeUrl` / `looksLikeUrl` branches explicit,
  do not merge them for brevity.
- Tests import `./setup.mjs` for window/document/location/chrome stubs;
  per-test DOM fixtures use save/restore (`prompt.test.js`, `shadow.test.js`
  pattern). Pure-logic suites (`rank`, `keymap`, `url`) need no stubs.
- `content/visual.js` starts with `/* eslint-disable */`; new shared modules
  must pass eslint (declare browser globals via `/* global ... */`).
- Commit messages: `refactor(scope): ...` / `fix: ...` / `feat: ...`,
  one logical change per commit with rebuilt bundles included.
